newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle prices up $2-$3 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle prices up $2-$3 - USDA.

text.p: - Feeder steers under 600 pounds steady, offerings over 600 pounds $2.00-$3.00 per cwt higher; feeder heifers steady, except 600-700 pounds, which were $2.00-$3.00 higher, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 350-800 lb feeder steers and heifers. Trade moderate. Demand good. Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 37 percent, over 600 lbs 53 percent with cows and bulls around 10 percent of total supply.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - few 600-700 lbs 80.50-84.50; 700-800 lbs 79.50-84.25; load 800 lbs 81.85, small lot 841 lbs 79.75, small lot fleshy 810 lbs 73.00; few 925-975 lbs 71.25-73.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-600 lbs 82.50- 85.00. Small and Medium 1-2 - 400-500 lbs 87.00-91.50.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 78.50-81.50; 700-800 lbs 74.50-76.10; part load 855 lbs 72.50.
